earlier_receipt: https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin/platforms/products/aladdin-studio (fetched Oct 20 2026, HTTP 200): "Aladdin Data Cloud (ADC) is a managed data-as-a-service offering that brings together Aladdin—the language of portfolios—with Snowflake's data platform to transform how you mobilize investment data." Also https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin/products/aladdin-data-cloud: "a next-generation data and analytics platform, powered by Snowflake's cloud-native technology". Neither page contains "Databricks" (case-insensitive grep of the full HTML), and the 1,943-line Aladdin sitemap (scratchpad crawl2/aladdin_sitemap.xml) has no Databricks URL. Buyer question, from https://d2adqanfijfsj5.cloudfront.net/captions/ala_build_vs_buy_captions_en.vtt 00:42:22.360-00:42:33.800: "what's the API suite that you have? / Are you using connectors to Snowflake or / to data bricks? / And I think that that part of the RFP has / become much more prominent." The speaker is Clark Schafer of Alpha FMC, not BlackRock.
earlier_finding: The Snowflake part is correct (Aladdin Data Cloud). No BlackRock source shows a Databricks connection; Databricks appears only in the buyer's question and as the competing build-your-own option. Reword to "the answer to the Snowflake and Databricks question buyers now ask (Data Cloud runs on Snowflake)", or confirm a Databricks path before implying one exists. Limit: this turn's WebSearch budget was used up, so no new web searches were made. Only the BlackRock pages, the captions and the sitemap were checked.

claim: I could not run anything, open the catalog, guides, notebooks or samples, or test what a client receives (the catalog, guides, notebooks and samples are not publicly openable)
earlier_receipt: https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin/platforms/products/apis : "Get a head start building with developer guides Download Python Jupyter Notebooks, or cut and paste code samples across multiple programming languages from carefully curated API guides, to build solutions in minutes. Discover the data you need Our Data Dictionary allows you to explore Aladdin data". The page's only Aladdin product links go to the Studio and APIs pages, with no link to the guides, notebooks or dictionary. Contradicting: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blackrock/aladdinsdk/main/README.md line 226: "Sample code snippets and user configuration files are provided under [`resources/sample_code_snippets`](resources/sample_code_snippets) directory in this code repository." sample_api_calls.md returns HTTP 200. README line 179: "AladdinSDK can run on a developer's local machine or in Aladdin Studio Compute sessions. There is also a test mode used by SDK developers."
earlier_finding: The catalog, the API guides and their notebooks and code samples are not publicly reachable. But the SDK's own sample code snippets are public on GitHub, so the bare word 'samples' is too broad. Say 'the catalog, the API guides or their notebooks and code samples'. 'Could not run anything' is the author's own account. It holds in substance, because every real call needs a client host and credentials.
